items.claim: Chanel Dyer holds significant advantages on the feet with greater power and headkick knockout ability.
items.quote: I think she's got big advantages on the feet. It's going to bring a lot more power. I mean, kicks are terrifying. She's got some headkick knockout ability, fast hand speed with, you know, striking flurries

items.claim: Elise Reed has lost all five of her professional losses by finish, including three by knockout.
items.quote: Five losses as a pro. Every single one of them finishes three by KO.

items.claim: Elise Reed is not a tremendous grappler who can neutralize explosive striking.
items.quote: I don't rate Reed as a tremendous grappler. I don't necessarily feel uh positional dominance and like neutralizing that explosive striking ability is probable.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer has a height advantage of two to three inches and a two-inch reach advantage over Elise Reed.
items.quote: She's got the height advantage, two, three inches taller, two inch reach advantage

items.claim: Wes Schultz defeated Jackson McVey via a quick submission in 40 seconds when they fought as amateurs in 2020.
items.quote: quick submission for the side of Wes Schultz like 40 second arm bar

items.claim: Jackson McVey has two professional losses by submission.
items.quote: You look at Jackson McVeyy's pro losses two by submission.

items.claim: Wes Schultz is a D3 All-American wrestler.
Jackson McVey's takedown defense remains seriously in question.
items.quote: Jackson McVeyy's takedown defense is still seriously in question.

items.claim: Jackson McVey was taken down three times and choked out by Zack Reese.
items.quote: We saw him taken down three times by Zack Reese. Then he got choked out by Zack Reese, too.

items.claim: Stan Dorsonville is stepping into the fight on short notice.
items.quote: he's stepping in on short notice, which in itself a red flag

items.claim: Stan Dorsonville holds a Brazilian jiu-jitsu black belt.
items.quote: has a Brazilian jiu-jitsu black belt.

items.claim: Stan Dorsonville possesses a 76-inch reach advantage.
items.quote: with a 76 inch reach, that's a nice advantage.
